offering_description.value: Provides cloud-based human capital management and payroll software to mid-sized employers. The platform covers payroll, HR, talent, benefits, time and labor, and employee engagement tools. It is delivered as software-as-a-service and sold mainly through a direct sales force.

primary_products.value: payroll software; human resources management software; time and labor management software; benefits administration software; employee engagement and communication tools

primary_services.value: payroll tax filing; implementation and customer support; benefits administration outsourcing

customer_segment.value: B2B: mid-sized and small employers across industries needing payroll and HR management

end_markets.value: human resources and payroll across industries; healthcare; professional services; manufacturing; nonprofits

revenue_model.value: subscription: recurring per-employee fees for cloud payroll and HR modules; interest or premiums: interest earned on client funds held before payroll tax and payment remittance; service fees: implementation and other fees
revenue_model.category: subscription; interest or premiums; service fees

value_chain_position.value: software / platform: develops and hosts cloud HCM and payroll platform sold to employers; service provider: processes payroll and tax filings on behalf of client employers

geography_served.value: US national: Clients across the United States, with a small presence in Europe

specialization.value: related lines: payroll, HR, talent, time, benefits and employee engagement modules on one platform

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: in-house sales force selling to employers; partners / resellers: referral relationships with accountants, benefits brokers and financial partners

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: payroll tax filing and money movement under IRS and state tax rules, employment law, and data privacy and security rules
